well past midnight.

yamlCheck.dateAnchor: July 9, August 6 and the night-of-August-6 label are spoken. Year 1749 and the proposed July 5 opening come from YAML. Post-midnight play followed by 2 AM, 6 AM, 8 AM and 9 AM supports a civil August 7 ending. The opening reporting scenes have no absolute dates.
yamlCheck.explanation: The July 9 arrival, weeks of downtime and August 6–7 journey fit the working YAML span, but the roughly three-day return and the earlier reports do not establish an exact July 5 earliest boundary. The one-day opening report interval and the August 6–7 midnight passage are explicit partial coverage; no exact total is claimed. Retrospective Hektor/Vola events are within downtime. The prior sanctum rest is not an additional dated night. July 29 is Marcella’s letter date and its travel time is reported background, not extra elapsed party time.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The source opens with newly narrated earlier reports before returning to the party’s aftermath. Their exact dates are not established.

alternatives.reading: YAML July 5 labels the party’s crater-aftermath opening; the earlier imperial reports precede that frame.
Including the retrospective reports in the earliest covered adventure boundary can move the start earlier; no exact earlier date is spoken.
